scripts.//llms-txt: gen-llms-txt.mjs and check-llms-txt.mjs read the content graph, which is TypeScript importing `server-only` — a specifier only a bundler resolves. So they run under tsx with the same shim the unit suite uses; as bare `node` they fail on their first import.
scripts.predev: node scripts/sync-figures.mjs && node scripts/gen-og-images.mjs && node scripts/gen-kb-menu-icons.mjs && node scripts/gen-wordmark-font.mjs && node scripts/gen-content-lastmod.mjs && node scripts/gen-cookie-policy-version.mjs && node --import tsx --import ./test/support/register.mjs scripts/gen-llms-txt.mjs
